Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly identified the winner of the 2019 British Academy Games Awards. The user asked for the 2019 winner, but WebSurfer immediately assumed the game was "God of War" (which won in 2018) and proceeded to search for its Wikipedia page. This fundamental error in identifying the correct game led to the entire subsequent analysis being based on the wrong subject. The agent failed to verify the actual winner before proceeding with the task.
